headline: Building the regular-season sample
introduction: We’re waiting for every team to reach five regular-season games. Once the sample is ready, the first Tuesday edition will appear here. Preseason and playoff results won’t enter these rankings.
methodology: Jay’s NHL Index: standings points percentage 25%, win quality 30%, offense 20%, defense 20%, last five games 5%. Win quality combines opponent points percentage (80%) and goal margin (20%). Every team needs five regular-season games before rankings are published.
